name: mug_inversion
description: Orientation-correction dual-handover: a YCB mug starts inverted (upside-down) on the left side of the table. A central wall blocks direct transfer, forcing the trajectory to detour around the +y corridor. Robot-1 (suction gripper) grasps the exposed bottom surface (facing up), lifts it, and hands off to Robot-0 (finger gripper) around the wall. Robot-0 re-grasps the mug by its rim, reorients it to upright, and places it on the right side of the table. The wall plus the 180° orientation change make the suction-to-finger handover essential.

ycb_objects._comment: Mug inverted (180° around Y-axis): bottom faces up, handle faces +y

custom_objects.name: wallObstacle
custom_objects._comment: Central wall: x=±0.03, y=±0.15, z=0.90–1.15. Blocks direct transfer, forcing the mug through a dual-arm handover.

target_pose._comment: Upright mug on the right side, handle pointing same direction as start (+y)
